properties.description: The queries in this script are used for data profiling and deciding best data types for Ontime data

content.query:
-- This is auto-generated code

-- Profiling only one file initially

SELECT
    TOP 10 *
FROM
    OPENROWSET(
        BULK '2022/01/T_ONTIME_REPORTING.csv',
        DATA_SOURCE = 'USOnTimeProject_Reporting',
        FORMAT = 'CSV',
        PARSER_VERSION = '2.0',
        HEADER_ROW = TRUE
    ) AS [OnTimeData]

--Record Count - 537902 for Jan file

SELECT
    COUNT(1)
FROM
    OPENROWSET(
        BULK '2022/01/T_ONTIME_REPORTING.csv',
        DATA_SOURCE = 'USOnTimeProject_Reporting',
        FORMAT = 'CSV',
        PARSER_VERSION = '2.0',
        HEADER_ROW = TRUE
    ) AS [OnTimeData]

    --Changing Data Types after analyzing columns

    SELECT
    TOP 10 *
FROM
    OPENROWSET(
        BULK '2022/01/T_ONTIME_REPORTING.csv',
        DATA_SOURCE = 'USOnTimeProject_Reporting',
        FORMAT = 'CSV',
        PARSER_VERSION = '2.0',
        HEADER_ROW = TRUE
    ) 
    WITH
    (
        FL_DATE DATE,
        OP_UNIQUE_CARRIER VARCHAR(10),
        OP_CARRIER_AIRLINE_ID INT,
        TAIL_NUM VARCHAR(10),
        OP_CARRIER_FL_NUM INT,
        ORIGIN_AIRPORT_ID INT,
        ORIGIN_AIRPORT_SEQ_ID INT,
        ORIGIN VARCHAR(10),
        ORIGIN_CITY_NAME VARCHAR(50),
        ORIGIN_STATE_ABR VARCHAR(5),
        DEST_AIRPORT_ID INT,
        DEST_AIRPORT_SEQ_ID INT,
        DEST VARCHAR(10),
        DEST_CITY_NAME VARCHAR(50),
        DEST_STATE_ABR VARCHAR(5),
        CRS_DEP_TIME INT,
        DEP_TIME INT,
        DEP_DELAY FLOAT,
        DEP_DELAY_NEW FLOAT,
        TAXI_OUT FLOAT,
        WHEELS_ON INT,
        TAXI_IN FLOAT,
        CRS_ARR_TIME INT,
        ARR_TIME INT,
        ARR_DELAY FLOAT,
        ARR_DELAY_NEW FLOAT,
        CANCELLED FLOAT,
        CANCELLATION_CODE VARCHAR(5),
        DIVERTED FLOAT,
        CRS_ELAPSED_TIME FLOAT,
        ACTUAL_ELAPSED_TIME FLOAT,
        AIR_TIME FLOAT,
        DISTANCE FLOAT,
        CARRIER_DELAY FLOAT,
        WEATHER_DELAY FLOAT,
        NAS_DELAY FLOAT,
        SECURITY_DELAY FLOAT,
        LATE_AIRCRAFT_DELAY FLOAT
    )
    AS [OnTimeData]

-- fetching from folders

-- total record count - 6718440

    SELECT
    COUNT(1)
FROM
    OPENROWSET(
        BULK '2022/**',
        DATA_SOURCE = 'USOnTimeProject_Reporting',
        FORMAT = 'CSV',
        PARSER_VERSION = '2.0',
        HEADER_ROW = TRUE
    ) 
    WITH
    (
        FL_DATE DATE,
        OP_UNIQUE_CARRIER VARCHAR(10),
        OP_CARRIER_AIRLINE_ID INT,
        TAIL_NUM VARCHAR(10),
        OP_CARRIER_FL_NUM INT,
        ORIGIN_AIRPORT_ID INT,
        ORIGIN_AIRPORT_SEQ_ID INT,
        ORIGIN VARCHAR(10),
        ORIGIN_CITY_NAME VARCHAR(50),
        ORIGIN_STATE_ABR VARCHAR(5),
        DEST_AIRPORT_ID INT,
        DEST_AIRPORT_SEQ_ID INT,
        DEST VARCHAR(10),
        DEST_CITY_NAME VARCHAR(50),
        DEST_STATE_ABR VARCHAR(5),
        CRS_DEP_TIME INT,
        DEP_TIME INT,
        DEP_DELAY FLOAT,
        DEP_DELAY_NEW FLOAT,
        TAXI_OUT FLOAT,
        WHEELS_ON INT,
        TAXI_IN FLOAT,
        CRS_ARR_TIME INT,
        ARR_TIME INT,
        ARR_DELAY FLOAT,
        ARR_DELAY_NEW FLOAT,
        CANCELLED FLOAT,
        CANCELLATION_CODE VARCHAR(5),
        DIVERTED FLOAT,
        CRS_ELAPSED_TIME FLOAT,
        ACTUAL_ELAPSED_TIME FLOAT,
        AIR_TIME FLOAT,
        DISTANCE FLOAT,
        CARRIER_DELAY FLOAT,
        WEATHER_DELAY FLOAT,
        NAS_DELAY FLOAT,
        SECURITY_DELAY FLOAT,
        LATE_AIRCRAFT_DELAY FLOAT
    )
    AS [OnTimeData]
    
    
    EXEC sp_describe_first_result_set N'SELECT
    TOP 100 *
FROM
    OPENROWSET(
        BULK ''https://adlsusontimeproject.dfs.core.windows.net/fsusontimeproject/OnTimeReporting/2022/01/T_ONTIME_REPORTING.csv'',
        FORMAT = ''CSV'',
        PARSER_VERSION = ''2.0'',
        HEADER_ROW = TRUE
    ) AS [OnTimeData]'
